prioritizeDesc: When ON, walk-in participants are set to 'Waiting'. After all registrations, assign them from the 'Reception Status' tab using the 'Assign Waiting Participants' button.
prioritizeGradeDesc: When ON, waiting walk-ins are assigned by grade (3rd yr → 2nd yr → 1st yr → Other). When OFF, it's first-come, first-served.
noCapstoneDesc: Your registration for not participating in the capstone experience is complete.
noCapstoneInfo: If you are only attending the Faculty of Engineering briefing, please register for it separately.

noWaiting: There are no participants on the waiting list.
noRosterData: Roster data has not been imported. Please import the roster file from the admin panel.
resetConfirm: All reception data (confirmed and waiting lists) will be reset. This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
resetComplete: Data has been reset. The page will now reload.
reloadDisabled: Reloading is disabled on this page to prevent data loss.
errorAlreadyRegistered: You are already registered or on the waiting list.
noChoicesProvided: You did not provide program preferences with your reservation, so you must select them now.
noCapstoneBriefingTime: {name}, your Faculty of Engineering briefing session starts at {time}.
offlineRequiredDesc: This application requires an internet connection. Please check your network and try again.
errorNetworkUnavailable: Network connection lost. Please check your connection and try again.
errorDatabaseWriteFailed: Failed to save to the database. Please contact staff for assistance.
noWaitingParticipants: There are no participants on the waiting list.
waitingAssigned: Assigned {count} participant(s) from the waiting list.
nameSearchNote: Family name or given name alone will do. Kana, romaji, or email also work.
nameSearchPlaceholder: e.g. yamada / 山田 / やまだ
candidatesNone: No matching reservation. Try a different spelling, or check in as a walk-in.
imageHint: Put the file in public/programs/ and enter its path here. Leave blank to show a placeholder.
assignmentModeNote: Decides the order in which programs are filled. Every mode except first-come holds attendees on a waiting list at check-in; run "Assign waiting list" on the Status tab once everyone has arrived.
modeFirstComeDesc: Confirms the program at check-in. Nobody waits.
modeReservedDesc: Confirms pre-booked attendees first, then fills the rest in arrival order.
modeGradeDesc: Year 3 → Year 2 → Year 1 → other. Use when exam-year students should get priority.
modeRepeatDesc: Assigns those who have attended most often first. Requires a visit-count column in the roster.
capstoneNoticeBody: The faculty briefing runs after the capstone experience. Choosing a capstone program still lets you attend the briefing. If you can only stay for the morning, or have somewhere to be afterwards, the briefing alone may suit you better.
briefingOnlyLead: Attending only the morning briefing? Choose this instead.
briefingOnlyTitle: Checked in for the morning briefing
briefingOnlyInfo: The faculty briefing starts at {time}. Please arrive at the venue before then.
partySizeLabel: How many are checking in together?
partySizeNote: Choose 2 or more and only programs with room for everyone will be selectable.
partyBanner: Checking in {count} together: {names}. Everyone joins the same program.
errorPartyTooLarge: This program does not have room for everyone in your group. Please choose another.
errorDuplicateInParty: That name is already used in this group.
modeScoreDesc: Turns reservation, school year, and past visits into points and assigns from the highest total down. One method instead of three.
scoreWeightsNote: The total decides the order. The reservation weight is set above what school year and visits can add up to, so a booked attendee is never overtaken by a walk-in.
scoreExample: e.g. booked Year 1, first visit = {a} pts / walk-in Year 3, 4th visit = {b} pts -> {winner} goes first.
backupNote: A snapshot is kept on this device every time someone checks in. If the browser data itself is cleared there is no way back, so pick a backup file once on the morning of the event.
backupStatusReady: Backup file is set. Saved automatically every {n} check-ins.
backupStatusNoTarget: No backup file set. The only copy is on this device.
backupStatusUnsupported: This browser cannot write backups automatically. Press "Back up now" regularly.
backupReminder: Check-ins are piling up with no backup file set. Download a copy now?
backupRestoreConfirm: This restores the state at that point and overwrites the current reception data. Continue?
backupImportFailed: Could not read that backup file. Please check the file.
